title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: There’s a chance I’m not allowed to do the podcast because “I don’t think Ron is the biggest fan of Fenech’s podcast.” Followed by “Do you know what you’d talk about?”

My MLB boss cleared it but did specify that we can talk nitty gritty of Sponsorship, monetization or anything that would alert MLB PR. That’s not anything you’d ask about, but just a heads up if this does get approved.

Sooooooooooooo I spoke with Ellen about it (haven't had a chance to run it by Ron) and she said you shouldn't. Mostly because there are still some baseball ops folks that aren't Fenech fans and I don't want to put you in an awkward scenario. I'll check and see what Ron says this afternoon.
Dude that’s fine. It’s up to you. I don’t necessarily think you should do it, either, but I promised so
Yeah, I’m gonna tell them I won’t do it, just hilarious there are so many people who hate you. Anyway, hope you are getting near the end of your article. Lot of us want to see it
